Trust & Governance

Corrections

An authority that hides its mistakes isn't one. Here is exactly what happens when CRI gets something wrong.

Effective and last reviewed: 2026-07-15

Report an error

Email hila@victoryroofer.com with the page URL and the issue, or use the contact form. Anyone may report an error — readers, contractors, manufacturers, competitors. The source of the report never affects how it is handled.

What happens next

  1. Acknowledgment. We confirm receipt within 2 business days.
  2. Verification. The claim is checked against sources under our Editorial Standards.
  3. Correction. Verified factual errors are corrected as soon as verification completes — target within 5 business days of the report.
  4. Disclosure. Material corrections are noted on the corrected page with the date and nature of the change.

What counts as material

  • Errors that could change a reader’s decision (costs, service life, code requirements, warranty conditions, safety guidance) are always material and always disclosed.
  • Typos and formatting fixes that do not change meaning are corrected silently.

Disagreements that aren’t errors

Sometimes qualified people disagree with our conclusions without a factual error being involved. Where a substantive methodological objection has merit, we update the page or add the competing view with its evidence — see Methodology.

Correction log

No corrections issued yet Material corrections will be listed here with dates and affected pages once the site is live.
